summary.content:
Today's selection covers 90 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: 'Claudy Day’ Trio of Flaws Exposes Claude Users to Data Theft
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Nordstrom's email system abused to send crypto scams to customers
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
